meta.source: Illustrative projection of the pinned release contracts. Every construct, definition, role, column, enum value, and check outcome below is transcribed from the tagged schema and test files; nothing is invented.

patterns.name: ConfidenceDisplay
patterns.constructDefinition: The observable representation of an AI system's uncertainty shown before a reliance decision.

patterns.name: RelianceDecision
patterns.constructDefinition: A participant's observable choice to accept or reject an AI recommendation.

patterns.name: OutcomeFeedback
patterns.constructDefinition: Information shown after a reliance decision that reveals whether the selected action was correct.

keyOutputColumns.name: decisionCorrectness
keyOutputColumns.detail: boolean (whether the reliance choice was optimal)

sharedColumnsNote: Every output row also carries patternName, patternVersion, trialIndex, scenarioId, and (for ConfidenceDisplay) aiOutput and aiIsCorrect as required columns; each pattern's output schema is closed (additionalProperties: false).

compositionCases.headline: Legal sequence, checked before any study runs
checks: Ordering respects each pattern's allowedAfter / allowedBefore constraints.
Required inputs are available from the initial input or earlier pattern outputs.
Output columns merge into one derived schema with column origins.
compositionCases.sourceNote: test: Sequence validates and derives a schema with column origins

compositionCases.headline: Illegal order and missing input, caught at design time
checks: OutcomeFeedback may only run after RelianceDecision, so starting with it violates the ordering constraint.
Reversing the sequence also removes the inputs later patterns require.
compositionCases.sourceNote: test: Sequence rejects missing inputs and disallowed ordering (asserts both error kinds)

compositionCases.headline: Branches must emit the same columns
checks: A Choice composition requires every branch to emit the same output columns.
The short branch omits the OutcomeFeedback columns, so the branches differ.
compositionCases.sourceNote: test: Choice requires branches to emit the same columns
